protocol.trajectory: one note moves linearly x=1.0 to x=0.0; encode current x only at each dt tick

training_duration.schedule_source: exact frozen Level 3B 120-block sequence; class labels are used only to schedule teaching and never enter sensory input

dan_stimulation.pulse_onset: the tick when the moving note reaches its arm-specific trigger position
dan_stimulation.model: same frozen LIF parameters; each DAN starts from fresh resting state
dan_stimulation.plasticity_gate: KC eligibility at the first spike of at least one anatomically connected ensemble DAN

arms: target teaching: stimulate on target-class scheduled notes at x=0.70; plasticity on
wrong-region teaching: stimulate on wrong-region scheduled notes at x=0.20; plasticity on
matched DAN-on/plasticity-off control: stimulate on target-class scheduled notes at x=0.70; plasticity off
protocol.eligibility: reset at the beginning of each note; observe current-note KC spikes through the first connected DAN spike; discard at note end
protocol.learning_rule: inherited presentation-local LocalLTD; eta and tau unchanged; no updates without positive local eligibility and active anatomically connected DAN
protocol.weight_commit: apply updates at note end; updated weights affect the next note; original run-start weights remain immutable for floor enforcement
protocol.action_validity: reset disabled at each note; enable on first KC spike of that note; thereafter action iff MBON05 voltage <= inherited fixed threshold
protocol.first_action_metric: earliest enabled dt sample with MBON05 voltage <= the fixed threshold; report its time and current position, or null if none
protocol.position_action_map: for each inherited 0.05 position bin, action is true if any enabled dt sample in that bin crosses the fixed threshold; bins with no enabled samples are disabled
protocol.post_training_evaluation: fresh 500-ms note per arm; DAN OFF, plasticity OFF, trained weights retained; same resettable first-KC-spike validity rule
predeclared_pass_criteria: naive baseline has no first action
target-trained post-training first action is within target core [0.65,0.75]
wrong-region-trained post-training first action is within wrong core [0.15,0.25]
matched DAN-on/plasticity-off control has unchanged weights and no first action
target and wrong first actions persist on fresh evaluation with DAN/plasticity OFF
no action occurs before the first KC spike in any training or evaluation note
all weight updates have positive current-note eligibility and an active anatomically connected DAN
all weights remain at or above 20% of immutable original weights
all 120 blocks and 1200 presentations complete in all arms
protocol.stop_rule: one run only; no parameter tuning, early stopping, or rerun; stop after Level 4C

scope: moving-note internal-learning experiment only; no osu timing scoring, trained decoder, or biological downstream motor neurons
